lines.zh: 跟随我的，是死神的脚步。
黑暗是我的武器，我无声。
我的每一步，都是死亡的影。
追踪，直到你成为我的晚餐。
lines.en: I will hunt until you're my meal.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，留下一串残影。
lines.en: Where I walk, a trail of afterimages stays.
My body and my shadow drift half a step apart.
I'm the afterimage — half a step behind you.

lines.zh: 隐匿于黑暗中，耐心等待。
静静等待，黑暗中的猎手。
lines.en: Wait, the hunter in the dark.

lines.zh: 耐心等待，猎物落入陷阱。
lines.en: Wait for the prey to fall.

lines.zh: 隐匿等待，直到猎物现身。

lines.en: Wait for the prey to get close.

lines.zh: 残影拖在身后，我锁定你了。
lines.en: My afterimage trails behind — you're locked.
That trailing smear in the shadow is me.
My eyes open in the black mist, facing you.

lines.zh: 你看到的是我，还是残影？
lines.en: Is that me you see, or an afterimage?

lines.zh: 我的视线留在原地，人会动。
lines.en: My gaze lags behind; the body moves on.
The afterimage breaks; the body remains.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒引来我了。
lines.en: The light on you calls to me.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气越来越清楚。

lines.en: The hunter calls, and I come.
Your scent comes down the wind.

lines.zh: 追随我，感受到黑暗的力量。
lines.en: Follow me, feel the power of the darkness.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的影子，永远不会消失。
lines.en: The shadow in darkness, never fades.
The messenger of darkness, devouring all.
Your bones will turn to dust.

lines.zh: 触碰到我的影子，你将消失。
lines.en: Touch my shadow, and you vanish.

lines.zh: 阴影中的匕首，致命一击。
lines.en: Dagger in the shadow, deadly strike.

lines.zh: 感受我的怒火，燃烧一切。
你的生命之线即将断裂。
lines.en: Your life thread is about to break.

lines.zh: 我是你无法战胜的噩梦。
我的影子，吞噬你的希望。

lines.en: Seek my shadow in the dark.

lines.zh: 我的影子是唯一的伴侣。
lines.en: My shadow is the only companion.

lines.zh: 黑暗的力量让我们结合。

lines.en: Dance with me, share the darkness.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的伴侣，彼此依存。
你的一举一动都在我的视野

lines.en: A gray blur in the darkness

lines.zh: 六十四格，我一路记着你。
lines.en: Sixty-four blocks, and I keep your trail.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，随时准备攻击
六十四格内，你的气味很清。
lines.en: Within sixty-four blocks, your scent is clear.

lines.zh: 轨迹记下了，从这到那儿。
lines.en: The trail is recorded, from here to there.
Run as you like; you still leave a trace.

lines.zh: 上一秒你在此，我已经到了。
lines.en: A second ago you were there. I am already here.

lines.zh: 我的目标，不会只有一次。
lines.en: I never target anyone just once.

lines.zh: 你转身的弧线，我预判到了。
lines.en: I predicted the arc of your turn.

lines.zh: 残影还留在原地，我到了。
lines.en: My afterimage stays behind; I've arrived.

lines.zh: 你的位置早进了我的轨迹。
lines.en: Your position is already in my trail.
My trail is closing in around you.

lines.zh: 后面那个是影子，前面是我。
lines.en: The one behind is the shadow; the one ahead is me.

lines.zh: 你砍中的只是一道残影。
别数我的脚印，数不清的。
lines.en: Don't count my footprints; there are too many.

lines.zh: 我在你身后留下第三道影。
lines.en: I leave a third shadow behind you.
You retreat, yet the afterimage comes from ahead.
My trail has already gone around your shield.
I lag half a beat; my shadow leads half a beat.
The black mist is full of my positions.

lines.zh: 你看得出哪个是真的吗？
lines.en: Can you tell which one is real?
A claw reaches out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 一击落下，残影跟着补上。
lines.en: One strike lands, and the afterimage adds another.
That blow from behind was also me.
The wound I open leaks black mist.

lines.zh: 我在你左右各留一道影。
lines.en: I leave one shadow on each of your sides.

lines.zh: 这一爪，跟着你的轨迹来。
lines.en: This claw follows your own trail.
You cannot see it, but it still catches you.
The shadow bites first; I arrive after.
You block the left; the right is open.
The afterimages scatter, then close in again.
Something is holding your feet, isn't it?
Everywhere you strike, it is still me.
The hunter's shadow settles in a corner.

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，只有残影。
lines.en: I have no footsteps, only afterimages.

lines.zh: 从黑雾里分出一个人形。
lines.en: A human shape separates out of the black mist.
You see the shadow first, then me.

lines.zh: 我踩空了，影子的轨迹断了。
lines.en: I missed a step; the shadow's trail breaks.
Even a shadow grows faint with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的残影散了。
lines.en: The bolt falls and my afterimages scatter.
